persons.name: Māgha
persons.evidence: kaviṣu māgha iti pratītaḥ kāvyaṃ vyadhatta śiśupālavadhābhidhānaṃ

notes: The colophon quotes the concluding autobiographical verse of the Śiśupālavadha naming the poet Māgha, followed by a scribal note noting the verse's presence in another copy ('sarggasamāptipadyānantaram ity adhikaṃ pustakāntare'). No scribal date or names of copyists/commissioners are given.
